# Screenshots

Images in `public/docs/`, referenced from docs pages as `/docs/<file>`. They
are captured with demo data by `node scripts/screenshots.mjs` (see the
comment at the top of that script).

## Web panel

1440×900, dark theme, with the players sidebar on the right.

| File | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `overview.webp` | Overview dashboard: server controls, players online chart, server stats, mini console, thread histogram, performance chart |
| `players.webp` | Players page: search bar, filters, roster with tags, online state, joined, last seen and playtime |
| `whitelist.webp` | Whitelist page on the Players tab, with Requests and Approvals tabs, export and import (empty list) |
| `history.webp` | History page: action search, type and admin filters, one warning row |
| `reports.webp` | Reports page: status counters, search, status and priority filters (no tickets) |
| `report-analytics.webp` | Report Analytics: ticket queue, 7- and 30-day rollups, daily activity table |
| `live-console.webp` | Live console with saved commands, search, filter, clear, download and options |
| `resources.webp` | Resources page grouped by folder, with counters, search, folder filter and per-resource state |
| `chat-commands.webp` | Chat Commands page on "Your commands" (empty), with the "From the /tx menu" tab |
| `server-log.webp` | Server Log: live/session picker, search, event-type filter chips |
| `admins.webp` | Admin Manager on the Admins tab: admin cards, Bulk Apply, Add Admin, Permission Presets tab |
| `insights.webp` | Insights: player retention, player count and memory charts, start of new vs returning players |
| `player-drops.webp` | Player Drops: expected and unexpected drop timelines, period overview, environment changes |
| `addon-manager.webp` | Addon Manager: one addon awaiting approval, one running with reload/stop/revoke and permission chips |
| `action-log.webp` | Action Log: live/session picker, search, category filter chips, a login entry |
| `diagnostics.webp` | Diagnostics on the Overview tab: CPU, memory, uptime, environment and runtime details |
| `artifacts.webp` | Artifacts (FXServer updates): current build, update state, available build tiers, custom URL |
| `panel-update.webp` | sxPanel Update: current version and an available update with Download & Verify |
| `settings.webp` | Settings on the Appearance tab, showing every settings tab name |

## In-game menu

Captured from the menu's browser mode on a dark backdrop (no game behind it),
cropped to the interface. Demo players and tickets.

| File | Shows |
| --- | --- |
| `menu-main.webp` | Main page of the `/tx` menu: page tabs, Self, Teleport, Vehicle, World, Staff Tools and Server actions, key hints |
| `menu-players.webp` | Players page: online player cards with vehicle icon, distance, health bar and Staff badge; search, filter and sort |
| `menu-stats.webp` | Stats page: players online, OneSync mode, resource count, uptime |
| `menu-resources.webp` | Resources page: resources grouped by folder with start/stop, restart, ensure and config-file actions |
| `menu-reports.webp` | Reports page for staff: ticket counters, active/archive lists, an open ticket with its conversation and Start Review / Resolve / Close |
| `menu-player-modal.webp` | Player profile in game, Actions tab: moderation, interaction, staff and troll actions; Info, IDs, History and Ban tabs |
| `menu-report-create.webp` | The player-facing New Ticket form: category, target players, priority, description |
| `menu-report-list.webp` | The player-facing My Tickets list with statuses and a feedback prompt |
| `menu-warning.webp` | Full-screen warning a player sees after being warned, with the hold-Space-to-dismiss hint |
| `menu-staff-hud.webp` | Staff dev tools overlay: coordinates HUD and entity inspector |
| `menu-announcement.webp` | A server announcement notification as players see it |
